pages.text: Aluminum is the light metal of the first drone frames. You cannot smelt it straight out of its ore: just as in real life, it takes electrolysis and a steady flow of power.$(br)$(li)$(item)Bauxite Ore$()$(br)$(li)$(item)Raw Bauxite$()$(br)$(li)$(item)Alumina$()$(br)$(li)$(item)Aluminum Ingot$()

$(li)Mine $(l)Bauxite Ore$(): rusty clumps in stone and deepslate, almost as common as iron, from y -32 to y 80 and most common around y 24. It drops $(l)Raw Bauxite$() (Fortune helps).$(br)$(li)Smelt or blast it (or the ore itself) into $(l)Alumina$(), a white powder.$(br)$(li)Put the Alumina in an $(l)Electrolyzer$(),

$(li)which takes a $(l)Cyber Frame$() on its left as you face it (right-click it alone and a drone shows where), and only works once assembled: $(l)1 Aluminum Ingot every 5 seconds at 80 FE/t$(). Two $(l:generators/combustion_generator)Combustion Generators$(/l) keep it running. The Electrolyzer takes Speed, Efficiency

$(li)and Battery $(l:drone_systems/addons)addons$(/l) on the tab beside its GUI. While it works, the feeder punch behind its window strikes four times per ingot and alumina grains drop into the bath; if the punch stops, so has the machine. Plug conduits into its free side, front or back: its top is full.$(br)Aluminum Ingots are tagged

forge:ingots/aluminum, Alumina forge:dusts/alumina, the ore forge:ores/bauxite and forge:ores/aluminum, Raw Bauxite forge:raw_materials/aluminum: aluminum from other mods works in every recipe, and their crushers and furnaces can process our ore.
Already have an aluminum ore from another mod? Set bauxiteGeneration = false under [world] in cyberfarm-common.toml and only theirs generates (new chunks only).
